## Problem 1

# Part a:
```{r}
data<-read.csv("Planet Money Cow Data - Sheet1.csv")
data = data[, 1]
```
This study is an observational study, or cross sectional survey more specifically.

# Part b:
```{r}
par(mai = c(1, 1, 0.2, 0.2))
hist(data, 500, main="Histogram of Cow Prices", xlab="Weight guesses (in lbs)", ylab="Frequency")
#true weight
abline(v = 1355, col = 2, lwd = 2)

```

# Part c:
```{r}
par(mai = c(1,0.2,0.2,0.2))
boxplot(data, horizontal = TRUE, main = "Horizontal Boxplot of Cow Prices", 
xlab = "weight guesses (in lbs)", frame.plot =FALSE)
#true weight
abline(v = 1355, col = 2, lwd = 2)
```
